The objective of this milestone is to isolate the designs and requirements of a stand alone on-boarding application in the form of documentation and then to develop said on-boarding application. The aim of the on-boarding application is to:
Elicit all the required data from a prospective asset owner that wishes to tokenize their real world asset. Once the owner entity data is collected, KYC must be performed to ensure that the entity meets the requirements of the legal agreement. The application should not allow rejected KYC entities to continue the process. If refused a refusal message should be displayed.
Once KYC is passed the entity will be allowed to enter data required to identify or verify an ownership claim. This information will then be used to verify the entities claim to the asset using the process researched and developed in milestone 2. If refused a refusal message should be displayed.
Once the asset ownership claim is verified the tokenization minting details should be elicited from the user. This includes but is not limited to the number of tokens to be minted. The token mint options must align with the constraints set forth in the legal agreement.
Finally to proceed

The objective of this milestone is to develop all block chain domain technologies relating to the RWA assets to be issued. This includes all smart contract development and transaction building systems for all aspects of the RWA life cycle, however at the time of writing the details RWA life cycle are not fully understood and will be dependent on the outcome discoveries of the regulatory investigation which take part in milestone 1.
What is known is we require mechanisms to perform the following in a regulatory compliant manner:
・The ability to mint onchain assets which will represent the RWA assets ownership rights.
・The ability to transfer said assets.
・The ability to burn said assets.
・What is unknown at this stage is:
・Whether RSA tokens will be represented as native cardano assets.
・How token transfer will be controlled.
・Whether native tokens will be permitted into a users wallet.
・How RWA asset transactions will be controlled.
・Under what conditions will RWA asset be permitted to be burnt.

Ideally we will make use of Cardano native tokens and constrain the tokens such that they can only be transferred if approval is granted by a licensed securities exchange authority, howeve
